name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: reliable manual writes for writable datapoints with robust boolean/string/number state handling
switch datapoints no longer use JavaScript truthiness, so string values like 'false' and '0' toggle correctly
missing or not-yet-subscribed state values are handled safely before direct switch/button writes
state value dialog shows boolean values consistently and writes JSON/Object mode correctly
object worker suppresses unchanged object events to reduce unnecessary React rerenders
objects-page DOM helper no longer rewrites titles continuously and avoids full-page scans on every mutation
role UI observer no longer watches title changes, reducing feedback loops on the datapoints page
delete/logquiet/role-guard behavior from v7.9.48 is preserved
notes: Fixes unreliable manual datapoint writes, especially switch/button states with null, undefined, 'false' or '0' values, and reduces UI overhead on the datapoints/object browser page.
